known_script_reuse_caveat.issue: sweep_grid35_first_action_seed.py's nearest_frame_trajectory_analysis() (via find_episode_files()) assumes one data file per episode, true for V2/V3's original per-episode-file layout but not for combined65, which merge_datasets packed into a single data/chunk-000/file-000.parquet for all 65 episodes. Against combined65 this makes every 'episode' key in nearest_demo_match read the same unfiltered whole-file state array, so the reported 'episode: 0' label is a mislabeling artifact - it does not mean the actual match is in episode 0.
known_script_reuse_caveat.verified_correction: The reported 'frame' value is actually the correct GLOBAL row index into the merged file. Directly checked: global row 10874 in so101_cube_pick_drop_combined65_v1 has episode_index=33, frame_index=25 - i.e. the true nearest-demo match for all 4 combined65 checkpoints' seed sweeps is combined65 episode 33 (= V2's original episode 33, unchanged index after merge), frame 25 - the exact same demo V2's own (correctly-labeled) sweep matched. l2_dist_deg (2.2171 deg) and gt_immediate_delta are bit-identical between the V2 baseline and all 4 combined65 sweeps, confirming the underlying nearest-neighbor search and GT delta computation are correct; only the (ep, frame) display label is wrong for combined65. No metric in this report (MAE, delta mean/std, clamp rate, L2-vs-GT) is affected by this - it is a cosmetic label bug in a reused diagnostic helper, not a data or training defect.
